description.s: Renders an array as a list of items, each edited with a specified field view. Accepts `itemSpec` (same shape as a ui_hints entry, e.g. `{field_view: "text"}`) and optional `defaultItem` (value inserted on Add). In editable mode shows up/down reorder buttons and a remove button per item. Falls back to field-view-json if the specified view cannot be loaded.
